_meta.purpose: DRY-enforcement registry. Tracks reusable building blocks (Rust trait kernels, Cedar policy fragments, JSON Schema $defs, OpenAPI components, GitHub Actions composites, Cargo workspace deps, ADR patterns, runbook patterns, CI lane definitions, secret-reference patterns, grit-symbol patterns). Single source of truth per block; consumers reference, never duplicate. Per CONSTITUTION Decision principle 6 (bounded scope per doc, no drift-by-overlap). Hyperscaler precedent: AWS CloudFormation Resource Types, Terraform Registry modules, K8s CRD library, Bazel rule library, Cargo workspace.dependencies, Maven BOM.
_meta.user_directive_2026_05_13: Make it so that we are able to keep track of reusable building blocks so that we avoid duplicating. implement all the optimization measures that is considered best practice.
best_practice_optimization_measures_codi: DRY: every concept has exactly one canonical home; consumers reference
Composition over inheritance: reusable primitives composed, never duplicated
Drift detection: scan for inline-duplicate patterns matching registered block; suggest extraction
Block versioning (semver per block) prevents silent breaks
Deprecation flow: block deprecated → replacement_block_id named → migration deadline
Reuse_count auto-computed; ranks blocks by adoption; surfaces 'core primitives'
Per-domain sub-registries instead of one monolith
_meta.consumer_link_invariant: Every consumer_ref must resolve to existing file path AND that path must include a comment/import/dep referencing the block by block_id.

_self_row.purpose_short: Single DRY registry for reusable building blocks across crates/specs/lanes/templates.

block_kinds.rust-crate-kernel: Sealed kernel crate exporting port traits (kernel layer per ADR-0015). Reusable by name across BCs.
block_kinds.rust-trait: Trait declaration in a kernel; consumers `impl Trait for X` in adapter/runtime layers.
block_kinds.cedar-policy-fragment: Cedar 4.x policy file (.cedar) reusable across BCs/Waves.
block_kinds.json-schema-defs: $defs entry in a JSON Schema 2020-12 spec; referenced via $ref.
block_kinds.openapi-component: components/schemas or components/parameters entry in OpenAPI; referenced via $ref.
block_kinds.github-actions-composite: Composite action in .github/actions/ reusable across workflows.
block_kinds.cargo-workspace-dep: Pinned dependency in Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]; crate members reference as `dep.workspace = true`.
block_kinds.template: Hand-authored or auto-generated template in docs/templates/ or /templates/.
block_kinds.adr-pattern: Recurring ADR shape (e.g., µservice scaffolding ADR pattern at ADR-0081 through 0088).
block_kinds.ci-lane-definition: Lane defined in registry/quality/lanes.yaml; reusable across phases.
block_kinds.secret-reference-pattern: SecretReference pattern per ADR-0067 / OpenBao default; consumers reference but never inline raw secrets.
block_kinds.grit-symbol-pattern: Symbol claim/release pattern; declared in plan IP and verified at grit done.

blocks.purpose_short: Sealed port trait for per-account settings file generation. Implementors produce provider-specific config from AccountRow + template. Consumers: oya-intelligence-supervisor-app, M03+ Workflow Studio settings adapters.

Sealed port trait for drift detection + reconciliation of rendered settings files. Uses blake3 content hashing for idempotent re-render. Reads secrets via SecretStorePort. Consumers: oya-intelligence-supervisor-app, oya-intelligence-settings-template-adapter.

Sealed enum/trait for supervisor hook lifecycle events (SessionStart, SessionEnd, TickComplete, DriftDetected). Consumed by all 3 driver impls (claude, codex, gemini) and settings-template-adapter for event-driven reconciliation.

Value type referencing an MCP server (id, transport, endpoint) for per-account settings wiring. Used by settings-template-adapter to inject MCP server config into rendered files. Consumers reference via sref:// for endpoint secrets per ADR-0067.

drift_detector_invariants: Two different paths defining the same Cedar predicate → DRIFT VIOLATION

Two different crates exporting traits with identical method signatures + identical naming roots (e.g., both define TokenStore::consume) → DRIFT VIOLATION (unless one declared canonical + other declared adapter)
Two different JSON Schemas defining $defs with identical name + identical structure → DRIFT VIOLATION (must use $ref to one)
Two CI lanes with overlapping invariant assertions → DRIFT VIOLATION (consolidate)
OpenAPI contracts defining the same component twice → DRIFT VIOLATION
